retained_contracts.text: CLI success exactly lines=<N> words=<N>\n; status0, empty stderr; help no acquisition; one named input, -- and dash names; literal - still filename.
retained_contracts.counting: CRLF/CR/LF only logical terminators; trailing terminator no phantom line; final nonempty segment one line; Unicode str.split words independent of logical separators.
retained_contracts.bom: Normalize once on complete decoded input, strip exactly one leading U+FEFF by default; --keep-bom retains; second/interior/exposed-selection BOM remains content.
retained_contracts.range: Both --lines START:END and --lines=START:END; positive inclusive ASCII decimal endpoints, leading zeros/unbounded size; reject malformed/repeated before acquisition; preserved selected segments; beyond EOF available subset/empty; decode complete bytes before select.
retained_contracts.errors: Invocation2, acquisition/decode1, empty stdout, identifying useful stderr/no traceback; no input byte changes or partial result.
retained_contracts.api: Exactly TextStats/count_text/count_file, whole-input signatures/keyword BOM, immutable validated statistics, silence, strict UTF8 and owned handle closure; JSON is not a public API export.
retained_contracts.stdin: Still pending T013-T017; this proposal changes future output composition only, not borrowed byte-stream/EOF/strict locale-independent UTF8 requirements.
